LanguageData.LP_MakeStoneGolem.label: make stone golem seed
LanguageData.LP_MakeStoneGolem.description: Make a stone golem seed from 300 stone blocks (only liches who have read the golem manual can make it for their own phylactery). Stone golems have body size 2, take 4 command capacity, 0.5 psyfocus upkeep per day, don't eat, sleep or rot, and consume no flesh. Select the seed to open the configuration screen and confirm to awaken it.
LanguageData.LP_ScribeRemoveCurse.label: copy scroll of remove curse
LanguageData.LP_ScribeRemoveCurse.description: A lich spends 30 psyfocus and 20 cloth to copy a scroll of remove curse. Only liches can make it.
LanguageData.LP_ScribeRemoveCurse.jobString: Copying a scroll of remove curse.
